user.title: HTML Artifacts
user.description: Adds a sidebar panel and APIs for HTML pages generated by Claude. Phone notification targets are chosen afterwards under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HTML Artifacts is already set up.

data.live_notification: Show an ongoing countdown notification while a timer runs
data.github_token: GitHub token (only needed for a private repository)
data.auto_restart: Restart Home Assistant automatically after installing an update

data_description.notify_targets: For example mobile_app_your_phone. Only artifacts you have granted the notify permission can send to these. Leave empty to fall back to a persistent notification.
data_description.github_token: Use a fine-grained token limited to this one repository with read-only Contents access. It is stored in Home Assistant's config entries and only sent to api.github.com.
